criteria.requirement: Fix binary Python generation for Pow so the entire Jinja AST left operand is grouped even when a negative Const is generated. Dynamic and constant/optimized/nonoptimized negative-base powers must agree for multiple bases and odd/even/zero/negative exponents. Preserve documented Jinja left-associative power chains (2**3**2=64), actual variable operands and sandbox intercepted-binop callback semantics. Do not merely special-case -1, change parser associativity or broadly alter unrelated generated binary expressions.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
